answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 41097 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Till what time we can eat Sehri Question: I want to ask that till what time we are allowed to eat sehri either till the time of imsak or till the time of Fajr azan? Answer ID: 41097 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1429/1054/D=1433) You can eat sehri till true dawn appears. However it is better to stop eating before some time as precaution. Azan is called after true dawn hence it is not lawful to eat till azan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
